description: Flat metadata schema for a single tumor sequencing record linked to a cancer patient, including consent, clinical history, biospecimen handling, sequencing, and genomic alteration summary fields.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for this metadata record within the dataset.

patient_id.descr: Pseudonymized patient identifier used to link repeated samples from the same cancer patient; must not be a direct personal identifier.

consent_obtained.descr: Whether informed consent was obtained for sequencing and data use (true/false).

consent_date.descr: Date informed consent was signed or recorded.

consent_scope.descr: Text or code describing permitted uses of the data, such as research-only, clinical return of results, data sharing, or recontact.

ethics_approval_id.descr: Institutional review board or ethics committee approval identifier for the study/protocol.

primary_cancer_type.descr: Primary cancer diagnosis, preferably using a controlled term or ontology label (e.g., breast invasive carcinoma).

primary_cancer_site.descr: Anatomic site of the primary tumor, such as lung, colon, ovary, or breast.

histology.descr: Histopathologic tumor classification, such as adenocarcinoma, melanoma, or lymphoma.

tumor_stage.descr: Clinical or pathologic stage at the time of sampling, using the local staging system or TNM-derived label.

tumor_grade.descr: Tumor grade or differentiation status, if available.

age_at_diagnosis.descr: Age in years at initial cancer diagnosis.

sex_at_birth.descr: Sex assigned at birth; acceptable values may include female, male, intersex, unknown.

race_ethnicity.descr: Self-reported race/ethnicity or equivalent demographic category, if collected and permitted.

family_history_cancer.descr: Whether there is a documented family history of cancer (true/false).

smoking_history.descr: Smoking exposure status at or before diagnosis; for example never, former, current, unknown.

other_relevant_exposures.descr: Text description of other relevant exposures or risk factors, such as asbestos, radiation, or occupational exposures.

sample_id.descr: Unique identifier for the tumor tissue sample.

sample_type.descr: Biospecimen type, such as primary tumor biopsy, metastatic lesion, or surgical resection.

sample_anatomic_site.descr: Exact tissue or lesion site from which the sample was collected.

sample_collection_date.descr: Date the tumor sample was collected.

sample_preservation_method.descr: How the sample was preserved, such as fresh frozen, FFPE, or liquid nitrogen.

tumor_cellularity_percent.descr: Estimated percentage of tumor cells in the sequenced specimen.

necrosis_percent.descr: Estimated percentage of necrotic tissue in the specimen.

pathology_reviewed.descr: Whether pathology review confirmed tumor content and sample adequacy (true/false).

microdissection_used.descr: Whether microdissection or enrichment was used prior to DNA extraction (true/false).

dna_extraction_method.descr: Method or kit used to extract DNA from the tumor tissue.

dna_input_ng.descr: Amount of DNA input used for library preparation, in nanograms (ng).

library_prep_kit.descr: Library preparation kit or protocol name.

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing instrument or platform used, such as Illumina NovaSeq or NovaSeq X.

sequencing_strategy.descr: Sequencing assay strategy, such as whole-genome sequencing, whole-exome sequencing, or targeted panel sequencing.

read_layout.descr: Read layout, such as single-end or paired-end.

read_length_bp.descr: Read length in base pairs (bp), for example 150.

target_panel_name.descr: Name of the targeted gene panel, if applicable.

reference_genome.descr: Reference genome build used for alignment and variant calling, such as GRCh37 or GRCh38.

alignment_tool.descr: Primary tool used for read alignment, such as BWA-MEM or equivalent.

variant_calling_pipeline.descr: Pipeline or software used to identify somatic variants.

germline_comparator_available.descr: Whether matched normal or germline comparator data were available for somatic calling (true/false).

matched_normal_sample_id.descr: Identifier of the matched normal sample, if available.

somatic_snv_count.descr: Number of somatic single-nucleotide variants detected in the sample.

somatic_indel_count.descr: Number of somatic insertion/deletion variants detected in the sample.

copy_number_alteration_present.descr: Whether clinically relevant copy-number alteration(s) were detected (true/false).

copy_number_alteration_summary.descr: Short textual summary of copy-number gains/losses or amplifications, if present.

structural_variant_present.descr: Whether structural variants or gene fusions were detected (true/false).

structural_variant_summary.descr: Short textual summary of structural variants, rearrangements, or fusions, if present.

microsatellite_instability_status.descr: Microsatellite instability status, such as MSI-high, MSI-low, or microsatellite stable.

tumor_mutational_burden.descr: Tumor mutational burden, typically reported as mutations per megabase (mut/Mb).

actionable_variant_present.descr: Whether at least one potentially actionable or therapy-relevant variant was identified (true/false).

actionable_variant_summary.descr: Text summary of clinically actionable variants, including gene and alteration when appropriate.

clinical_significance_level.descr: Overall interpretation tier for the most relevant variant, such as pathogenic, likely pathogenic, VUS, or benign.

current_treatment_line.descr: Current or most recent treatment line at the time of sampling, such as first-line, second-line, or maintenance.

prior_therapies.descr: Text description of prior systemic therapies, surgery, radiation, or other treatments received before sampling.

current_therapy_at_sampling.descr: Therapy the patient was receiving at the time the sample was collected, if any.

treatment_response_status.descr: Observed response status around the time of sampling, such as response, stable disease, progression, or unknown.

recurrence_status.descr: Whether the cancer was primary, recurrent, or metastatic at the time of sampling.

biobank_id.descr: Optional biobank or repository identifier for the specimen.

data_sharing_allowed.descr: Whether the consent and governance framework allow data sharing beyond the originating site (true/false).

de_identified.descr: Whether direct identifiers have been removed or pseudonymized (true/false).

qc_passed.descr: Whether the sample and sequencing data passed predefined quality-control criteria (true/false).

qc_notes.descr: Text notes describing any quality-control issues, filtering, or caveats.
